items.title: Uses both hands together to manipulate objects, like opening a box.
Likes soft things more than rough ones.
Gets into a crawling position on hands and knees.
Rocks back and forth in the crawling position.
Wrinkles paper using both hands.
Uses one arm to lift their upper body while on their tummy.
Goes from sitting to standing with the aid of a large object, like furniture.
Moves from sitting to being on their knees.

anchor.title: Stays focused on something or someone for a while (1 minute).

items.title: Matches sound to object, such as a doorbell with the door.
Moves to the rhythm of music.
Copies facial expressions.
Looks for a toy that was just hidden.
Discovers things hidden under blankets or covers.
Imitates simple gestures after seeing them.
Clears the path to grab what they're after.
Tests cause and effect by dropping an object and seeing if you'll pick it up.

anchor.title: Lets likes and dislikes be known by making facial expressions.

items.title: Asks for help by babbling.
Knows what 'no' means.
Babbles like they are in conversation with you and takes turns talking.
Looks at things or people when called by name.
Tries to copy the words you say.
Answers with babbles when you talk to them.
Imitates a sound like 'pa' after you say it.
Talks to other babies with babbles.

anchor.title: Stares at the person who is talking to them.

items.title: Repeats sounds or actions to get people to look.
Explores on their own with a caregiver nearby.
Feels shy or anxious when meeting new adults.
Gets upset when playtime is interrupted.
Plays and has fun with other kids.
Lifts their arms to be carried.
Helps with the dressing and undressing processes by moving the right body parts.
When they hear their name, they move toward the person by crawling, walking, or turning in their direction.

calibration.title: Points to or names characters from familiar stories.
Names simple shapes like a circle, triangle, or square.
Says simple words with the letter N, like 'nap' or 'banana'.
